content: पुण्ड्रः [पुण्ड्-भेदने रक् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 13</ls>] .²1 A kind of sugarcane (red variety). .²2 A lotus in general. .²3 A white lotus .²4 A mark or line (on the fore-head) made with sandal <ab>&c.</ab>, sectarial mark; उत्थं तत् पुण्ड्रमूर्ध्वं जनिमरणतमःखण्डनं मण्डनं च <ls>Viṣṇupāda. S. 43</ls>. .²5 A worm. .²6 The {%Atimukta%} creeper. .{@-ण्ड्राः@} (<ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a country and its inhabitants.
